Grok Bot、Codex 和 Antigravity 共用服务连接，各自保存: Grok Bot, Codex, and Antigravity share one service connection, with a separate generation session for each engine.
填写 AgentRelay 首页显示的根地址。三个引擎自动使用对应接口前缀，无需: Enter the base URL shown on the AgentRelay home page. Engine paths are added automatically; do not append /grokbot, /codex, or /antigravity.
测试会发送一条验证消息，收到完整回复后保存。采集、评论和知识库可分别选择引擎与会: Testing sends a verification message and saves the connection after a complete reply. Collection, replies, and the knowledge base can each use their own engine and session. Changing settings does not resend existing tasks.
运行 AgentRelay，并确认对应客户端已登录。如提示来源未授权，在 Age: Run AgentRelay and sign in to the corresponding client. If the origin is not authorized, allow this extension origin in AgentRelay:
配置和 Token 仅保存在本机扩展数据库。旧 Grok Bot 配置会自动读取: Settings and tokens are stored only in this extension's local database. Existing Grok Bot settings are loaded automatically, and existing tasks continue to use their original connection.
请允许访问 AI 服务: Allow access to the AI service
连接正常，请选择会话并测试保存: Connected. Select a session, then test and save.
测试通过，连接和会话已保存: Test passed. Connection and session saved.
会话已创建，请测试并保存: Session created. Please test and save.
复制失败，请手动复制上方扩展地址: Copy failed. Copy the extension origin above manually.
发现互关意愿 · 用评论建立联系: Find mutual-follow invitations · Connect through replies
选择本页全部记录: Select all records on this page
权重当前降序，点击升序: Priority: descending. Click to sort ascending.
权重当前升序，点击降序: Priority: ascending. Click to sort descending.
请保留已登录的 X 页面后刷新: Keep a signed-in X page open, then refresh.
暂无帖子记录。先开启采集与打标，再按需开启评论。: No posts yet. Enable collection and labeling first, then enable replies when ready.
等待评论调度: Waiting for the next reply run
定时读取首页新帖，批量识别互关意愿并入库。: Collect new feed posts on a schedule, identify mutual-follow invitations in batches, and save them.
从已打标的互关帖中生成评论并发布，不主动关注。: Generate and publish replies to labeled mutual-follow posts, without following their authors.
优先通过首页接口分页，相当于下拉加载。0 表示仅取首页第一批；遇到已保存的帖子锚: Uses feed pagination when available, equivalent to scrolling for more posts. Set 0 to collect only the first batch. Stops early when a saved post anchor is found and the page contains no new posts. Each run uses a temporary window that closes when finished.
将多条新帖合并为一次 AI 请求，按引擎输入长度自动分批；已保存的标签不重复请求: Combines new posts into a single AI request, splitting batches to fit the engine's input limit. Saved labels are not requested again.
按北京时间统计；待核实的发送也计入上限。发送之间随机间隔1至3分钟。: Counted by Beijing time. Sends awaiting verification also count toward the limit. Replies are spaced randomly 1–3 minutes apart.
与关注队列一致，按评论语言追加互关邀请，例如：关注我，必回关！🤝。已有同义文案不: As in the follow queue, adds a mutual-follow invitation in the reply's language, such as: Follow me and I'll follow back! 🤝. Equivalent invitations are not duplicated. If it will not fit, the draft is retained without truncating the reply.
配置已保存到本机，刷新或重新打开后仍会保留。: Settings are saved locally and will remain after refreshing or reopening.
按最近采集的关注状态计算。已打标且未关注：1000 +（评论×1 + 转发×3: Based on the last collected follow status. Labeled posts from accounts you do not follow receive 1000 + (replies × 1 + reposts × 3 + likes × 3 + bookmarks × 3) % 1000. Other posts receive no extra weight. Engagement score:
。同权重按尝试时间、采集时间排序。: . Ties are sorted by attempt time, then collection time.
已安排扫描，执行进度会自动刷新: Scan scheduled. Progress will refresh automatically.
与关注队列一致：最多选择10个候选，每条按评论语言随机追加最多2个。空间不足时减: As in the follow queue: choose up to 10 candidates. Each reply gets up to 2 random hashtags matching its language. Fewer hashtags are used if space is limited; reply text is never truncated. Resumed replies keep their original hashtags.
最多选择10个标签，请先取消其他标签。: Select up to 10 hashtags. Deselect another hashtag first.
请输入单个标签，不含空格或标点。: Enter one hashtag without spaces or punctuation.
最多保存50个自定义标签。: You can save up to 50 custom hashtags.
从已登录的 X 页面读取账号，点击重试: Read the account from a signed-in X page. Click to retry.
读取粉丝与关注列表，识别待回关账号，查看资料、标签和关系变化。: Read follower and following lists, identify accounts awaiting a follow-back, and view profiles, labels, and relationship changes.
查看互关关系与候选账号，补全公开资料，并将符合条件的账号加入关注队列。: Review mutual follows and candidate accounts, complete public profiles, and add eligible accounts to the follow queue.
在 X 帖子操作栏点击评论追踪图标，收集评论用户。可按关系筛选并查看来源。: Click the reply tracking icon on an X post to collect accounts that replied. Filter by relationship and view their source posts.
定时扫描首页，由 AI 判断互关意愿并评论。只留言、不主动关注，可回溯原帖、判断: Scan the feed on a schedule and use AI to identify mutual-follow invitations and reply. This sends replies without following accounts. Review original posts, classifications, and publication results.
追踪自己的帖子与回复，监控最近 30 条。可筛选、分析和保留内容；删除前需确认。: Track your 30 most recent posts and replies. Filter, analyze, and retain content; deletion requires confirmation. See the guide for details.
按昨日净增排名，定时采集并生成日报。在 X 帖子操作栏点击灰色 X 图标，将作者: Rank accounts by yesterday's net growth, collect data on a schedule, and generate daily reports. Click the gray X icon on a post to add its author to the leaderboard.
统一管理待处理账号，按配置执行资料检查、关注和引用评价，并查看任务状态与执行日志: Manage pending accounts, run configured profile checks, follows, and quote replies, and review task status and execution logs.
检测主动关注账号是否回关。超过设置期限仍未回关的账号归为超时；取关前请核对所选范: Check whether accounts you followed have followed you back. Accounts that have not done so within the set period become overdue. Review your selection before unfollowing.
批量分析帖子，积累经验并合入智慧。生成时按开关引用当前智慧，经验与历史版本按账号: Analyze posts in batches and combine insights into knowledge. Use the current knowledge during generation when enabled. Insights and version history are stored separately for each account.
最早保留快照之后的变更条数，不是账号数，也不包括执行日志。: Number of changes since the oldest retained snapshot. This is not an account count and excludes execution logs.
显示最近成功快照的隔离恢复校验结果，不代表此刻重新校验。: Shows the isolated restore verification result for the latest successful snapshot. It does not run a new check.
关闭后仍保存业务变更增量，但不定期生成快照和清理旧增量；可手动备份。: When off, data changes are still recorded, but snapshots and old-change cleanup are not scheduled. Manual backups remain available.
仅显示本机开始记录后的安装与升级，不推断更早的版本经历。: Only shows installations and upgrades recorded on this device. Earlier version history is not inferred.
尚无本机安装或升级记录。: No installation or upgrade records on this device yet.
记录版本变更及本地数据迁移的启动、完成或失败；最近保留 200 条。: Records version changes and local data migration starts, completions, and failures. Retains the latest 200 entries.
尚无升级日志；既往未记录的过程无法补造。: No upgrade logs yet. Previously unrecorded activity cannot be reconstructed.
保存后回到第一页并立即应用；重新打开面板仍使用此默认值。列表顶部可临时调整。: Applied immediately on save, returning to page 1. This default remains when reopening the panel. You can temporarily change it above each list.
默认 30 条，打开执行日志时生效。: Defaults to 30 entries. Applied when opening execution logs.
打开日志时按此范围查询，翻页保持相同时间边界；不会删除历史日志，执行日志与业务备: Uses this range when opening logs and keeps the same time boundaries across pages. Historical logs are not deleted. Execution logs are separate from data backups.
默认 8 分钟。Grok 窗口释放或结束前台使用后开始计时；保存后在下次释放或触: Defaults to 8 minutes. Starts when a Grok window is released or leaves foreground use. After saving, the new value applies the next time the window is released or used.
默认 15 分钟，新临时窗口的最低保留时间；任务申请更长时间时优先保障任务。: Defaults to 15 minutes: the minimum lifetime for a new temporary window. Tasks requesting more time take priority.
默认每 1 分钟检查。只回收扩展拥有的闲置窗口；前台、忙碌、人工验证及常驻窗口保: Checks every minute by default. Only idle windows owned by the extension are closed. Foreground, busy, verification, and persistent windows are kept.
默认保留 3 份，可设 1–10 份。减少数量在下次新快照恢复校验通过后生效。: Retains 3 snapshots by default; choose 1–10. A lower limit takes effect after the next new snapshot passes restore verification.
默认 1,000 条。与最长间隔满足任一条件时，在下次后台检查生成新快照。: Defaults to 1,000 changes. A new snapshot is created at the next background check when either this threshold or the maximum interval is reached.
默认 24 小时，有新变更才生成快照，没有变化不会重复备份。: Defaults to 24 hours. Snapshots are created only when there are new changes; unchanged data is not backed up again.
默认每 60 分钟检查备份条件。保存后更新后台计划；浏览器关闭期间不执行。: Checks backup conditions every 60 minutes by default. Saving updates the background schedule. Checks do not run while the browser is closed.
已填入默认值，保存后生效: Defaults filled in. Save to apply.
语言偏好保存失败，请重试: Could not save your language preference. Please retry.
服务地址须为本机HTTP或HTTPS根地址，不含路径、查询或凭据: Use a local HTTP or an HTTPS base URL, without paths, query parameters, or credentials.
会话配置与所选引擎不符: The session configuration does not match the selected engine
请输入 1–65535 的端口号: Enter a port number from 1 to 65535
无法连接AI服务，请检查地址、端口及扩展来源设置: Cannot connect to the AI service. Check the URL, port, and allowed extension origins.
AI服务返回无效数据: The AI service returned invalid data
服务未允许此扩展来源: The service has not allowed this extension origin
会话、任务或接口不存在，请确认引擎和服务版本: Session, task, or endpoint not found. Check the engine and service version.
所选引擎暂不可用，请在 AgentRelay 检查客户端连接: The selected engine is temporarily unavailable. Check the client connection in AgentRelay.
未能读取会话列表: Could not load the session list
AI未返回有效结果: AI did not return a valid result
发送状态待确认，请检查原会话: Send status is unconfirmed. Check the original session.
AI任务未完成，请检查所选引擎: AI task incomplete. Check the selected engine.
AI尚未回复，可稍后查询原任务: AI has not replied yet. Check the original task again later.

Grok Bot请使用已有Bot: For Grok Bot, use an existing bot
请输入1～100字的会话名称: Enter a session name of 1–100 characters
AI正在生成，可继续查询原任务: AI is generating. You can keep checking the original task.
请先在系统设置测试AI引擎: Test the AI engine in System settings first
